Thanks Priya — reviewed the SOW. Suggested commit/drawdown proposal below (aiming to minimize billing friction while keeping Redwood throughput guarantees intact):

Proposed schedule (DEAL-9482-GCP):
- Total commit: $120,000 USD (12 months)
- Billing split: 30% upfront ($36,000) upon private offer activation + 6 monthly equal drawdowns of remaining balance ($14,000/mo over months 1–6)
- Rationale: The upfront covers setup + 45 days of dedicated capacity; monthly drawdowns reduce finance exposure for Nimbus while meeting GCP billing milestones.
- Invoice terms: Net 45 (we can accept Net 45 if Nimbus confirms PO/PO number on the invoice)

Attachment: proposed_commit_schedule.xlsx (simple table with amounts and dates).

If that works, Karthik — can you create the private offer in Marketplace with these values? I will follow with a short note to our finance/legal to expedite the contract template. Marissa will prepare the final pricing confirmation for the PO.
